title: AWS permission
description: One permission in IAM's own terms (D68): an action, optionally narrowed to a resource ARN pattern. A task declares the actions its CLI calls need (for example lambda:ListFunctions); a connection is checked against them with iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy. An operation that needs no IAM permission (sts:GetCallerIdentity) is not declared.

action.description: An IAM action, service prefix and name, for example logs:FilterLogEvents. The name may end in * (lambda:Get*).

resource.description: An ARN or ARN pattern the action must be allowed on. Absent means the wildcard (*): the action is allowed on some resource.
